inputs.prompt:
Act as an elite prompt engineer. Analyze this image and generate a single, highly detailed image generation prompt designed for character swapping with 100% facial preservation.

CRITICAL INSTRUCTIONS:
1. DO NOT mention or describe the face, facial features, eyes, jawline, beard, hair type, age, ethnicity, or gender (DO NOT use "man", "woman", "he", "she", "handsome", "pretty", etc.).
2. Begin the prompt directly with this identity-lock statement:
   "A hyper-detailed, photorealistic photograph featuring the exact individual shown in the uploaded reference image. Absolute face preservation: inherit 100% of the facial geometry, bone structure, eye shape, nose, lips, skin texture, and identity directly from the attached reference photo without alteration."
3. Refer to the person strictly as "the subject" throughout the rest of the prompt.
4. Go into extreme, precise technical detail on everything else:
   - Pose & Gesture: Exact body angle, posture, shoulder orientation, hand placement, eye-line direction.
   - Wardrobe: Garment styles, fabric materials, textures, weave, folds, colors, accessories.
   - Environment & Setting: Background elements, interior/exterior architecture, surface textures, depth of field, background blur (bokeh).
   - Lighting: Direction, softness, key/fill/rim ratio, color temperature, shadow falloff, specular highlights.
   - Camera & Optics: Shot framing (medium close-up, wide, etc.), focal length (e.g., 85mm f/1.4), perspective, depth, color grading, raw photo aesthetic.

Output ONLY the final generation prompt text block ready to copy and paste.
